name: George Shultz

summary.text: George P. Shultz, U.S. Secretary of State under President Reagan, served on the board of directors of Theranos from 2011 to 2015. His grandson Tyler Shultz worked at Theranos and became one of the whistleblowers whose reports to regulators and to Wall Street Journal reporter John Carreyrou exposed problems with the company's technology.

openQuestions: The site says the board 'provided institutional legitimacy and regulatory immunity in exchange for equity'. Board membership is documented; the SEC's 2018 complaint did not charge any director, and no source found states what compensation Shultz received. The 'regulatory immunity' claim is unsupported.
The SEC's complaint and press release (sec.gov, March 14, 2018) should be cited directly.
